description: Chintu hathi aur Mithu tota sikhayenge brush karna. Bacche khushi-khushi apne daant saaf karna seekhenge.
learning: Teaches toddlers the habit of brushing teeth twice a day.

scenes.text:
दांतों की रेल चली, मजे से ब्रश करो,
चलो, चलो, चलो, तुम ब्रश करो!
scenes.image_prompt: A cute orange baby elephant with a blue scarf and a tiny green parrot wearing a red cap sitting on a giant colorful toothbrush moving on a bathroom floor.

scenes.text:
Up and down, left and right,
Brush your teeth, keep them bright.
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of the little green parrot holding a toothbrush and showing the elephant how to brush his big white teeth.

scenes.text:
चिट्टे दांत चमकते प्यारे,
मम्मी-पापा खुश हैं सारे।
scenes.image_prompt: The orange elephant laughing and showing his sparkling clean white teeth in a mirror.

scenes.text:
दांतों की रेल चली, मजे से ब्रश करो,
चलो, चलो, चलो, तुम ब्रश करो!
scenes.image_prompt: The elephant and the parrot riding the toothbrush train forward with sparkles behind them.

scenes.text:
One, two, three, four, count them well,
Brush away the sugar smell.
scenes.image_prompt: The little parrot pointing at the elephant's teeth while counting them with his wing.

scenes.text:
अंदर-बाहर, नीचे-ऊपर,
साफ करो अब अपना मुँह भर।
scenes.image_prompt: The parrot demonstrating a circular brushing motion on the elephant's tooth.

scenes.text:
दांतों की रेल चली, मजे से ब्रश करो,
चलो, चलो, चलो, तुम ब्रश करो!
scenes.image_prompt: The toothbrush train traveling across a bright bathroom sink with bubbles floating around.

scenes.text:
Morning time, start the day,
Brush the sleepy germs away.
scenes.image_prompt: The sun shining through a bathroom window, the elephant yawning and holding his toothbrush.

scenes.text:
रात को सोने से पहले भाई,
ब्रश करना कभी न भूलना आई।
scenes.image_prompt: The elephant and the parrot ready for bed with toothbrushes in their hands.

scenes.text:
दांतों की रेल चली, मजे से ब्रश करो,
चलो, चलो, चलो, तुम ब्रश करो!
scenes.image_prompt: The two friends doing a happy dance on the bathroom floor after brushing.

scenes.text:
Tiny brush and minty paste,
Do not let a minute waste.
scenes.image_prompt: The green parrot squeezing a tiny amount of blue toothpaste onto the toothbrush.

scenes.text:
साफ-सुथरे चमकें दांत,
खुशियाँ लाए दिन और रात।
scenes.image_prompt: A wide shot showing the elephant looking very happy and shiny in the mirror.

scenes.text:
दांतों की रेल चली, मजे से ब्रश करो,
चलो, चलो, चलो, तुम ब्रश करो!
scenes.image_prompt: The elephant and parrot high-fiving each other in the sparkling clean bathroom.
